offers_products.reason: Manufactures medical devices and components such as catheter liners, batteries and delivery systems for device makers.

offers_services.reason: As a CDMO it provides contract engineering, development and manufacturing services to medical device customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are medical device companies; patients do not choose or buy its components.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to medical device OEMs in cardio, vascular, neuromodulation and cardiac rhythm management.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat production orders from OEMs for components used in ongoing device production, under long-term supply relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to medical procedures and devices, which are non-discretionary and stable in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Components are supplied in repeated production orders, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured components and devices, produced with plants and technology, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large medical device makers (major OEMs) in cardio and neuromodulation markets.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many manufacturing plants needing ongoing capital for precision equipment and capacity.
